name: io.github.jiangzhangcc-glitch/signals-api-mcp
title: AI Signals (Signals API)
description: Daily AI signals as data for agents: today's four signals from GitHub, Hugging Face, arXiv and industry news, what changed since the previous edition, and ranked AI models and repositories. Every row links to its original source; numbers that cannot be derived are reported as unranked with the reason instead of being invented. Free tier, no API key.
